violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: beans empanada stuffing empanada stuffing, brisket the empanada stuffing, buffalo empanada stuffing, caprese empanada stuffing, greens empanada stuffing.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CORRECTED. All were discarded during the inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the cook-line is broken can no longer be operated, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. Repair the broken sink or replace it if it can no longer be repaired .

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions currently in the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIUM COMPOUND A, test kit.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the cook-line hand washing sink are leaking and this sink is no longer operable.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Repair or rep[lace this sink and make it available for hand washing.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor drain under the 3-vat sink is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean and maintain the floor drains in clean condition at all times.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: UNSALTED BUTTER=47F, SHREDDED CHEESE=44F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Moved both to the n walk-in refrigerator for proper cold holding. CFM will have the reach-in refrigerator checked and adjusted for proper ambient temperature..

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Two-door upright refrigerator located next to the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.
